title: Reactive protection covers (atlas docs/atlas/protection-priorities.md)
description: The deck's instant-speed protection cards, ranked by cost. Consumed at runtime by EngineFacade.loadProtection -> ComboPilot.ProtectionSpec. Uniform across all decks; a deck may hold none (empty covers).

scope.description: A ProtectionFinder.Scope enum name (CREATURES / ALL_PERMANENTS / ...). Loader does Scope.valueOf — an unknown value throws at load; kept as string here rather than a partial enum.
